name: 予定と実績を並列の棒で比較する工数グラフのひな型
prompt:
Recreate the standalone Asana chart tile in the primary source crop. Match its 300:206 aspect ratio (about 1.46:1), rounded white card, fine neutral border, padding and chart placement. The original screenshot controls the four bar groups, heights, colors, chart guide and “New” marker; use the Japanese mock only for translated title wording.

At the top left, use the compact Japanese title 「担当者別の予定と実績の工数」 in dark, medium-weight type. Keep it readable on one line if it fits naturally. Place the small purple 「New」 marker at the upper right, aligned with the first title line.

Below the title, show exactly four side-by-side pairs of vertical bars, with no category labels, values or axis numbers. Each pair has one lavender-purple bar followed immediately by one rose-pink bar. Preserve the source order and relative heights: first pair medium/medium-tall; second pair medium/medium-tall; third pair short/tallest; fourth pair medium/tall with the purple bar slightly taller than the pink. Use the original bar widths, pair spacing, lower alignment and one very faint horizontal guide behind the bars.

Do not use the mock’s three green pairs. Keep the source’s two-series purple/pink palette and all four pairs. Do not add legends, labels, data, axes, grid lines beyond the single faint guide, or page context.
reviewNotes: Candidate v001 compared side-by-side with the original 2x crop. Dimensions 1513x1040 (1.4548:1) against source 300x206 (1.4563:1); SHA-256 500e06954eb23373eba373c40ce363c31b1451bc78eeae904607ed548b5b32c4. Four purple/pink pairs and their relative heights are correct, but the whole plot (bars and faint guide) sits about 4% too high, and pair spacing spreads the last bars too far right. Status: needs-correction; one focused revision remains.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
